crossRefs.note: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?
This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light; for…
For everyone who does evil hates the light, and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.
Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are…
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…
God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.
For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.
By Yahweh’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.
to him who spread out the earth above the waters; for his loving kindness endures forever:
By faith, we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made…
He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

translations.web: For this they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,
translations.bsb: But they deliberately overlook the fact that long ago by God’s word the heavens existed and the earth was formed out of water and by water,
translations.kjv: For this they willingly are ignorant of, that by the word of God the heavens were of old, and the earth standing out of the water and in the water:
translations.asv: For this they willfully forget, that there were heavens from of old, and an earth compacted out of water and amidst water, by the word of God;
